subject: Purchase header sequencing and billing eligibility — PO field constraints
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@acmeco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmeco.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase headers & billing cadence — sample PO attached

Ben,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement is ready to move but we have a few mandatory PO requirements from our AP team that we need validated before we can issue a blanket PO. Attached is a sample PO (AcmeCo_PO_83421.pdf) that shows the fields we require:

- PO header must include: "Bill To GL (6 digits)", "Cost Center", and "Business Unit" fields populated.
- We need invoices to be consolidated monthly (one invoice per month) rather than weekly.
- Net terms: Acme typically uses net45 for new vendors; we can consider net30 after the first two quarters.
- Discounting: discounts are applied at the invoice level when there is a quarterly commit threshold — can you confirm if Redwood can apply a quarterly-volume discount (slab) and surface the discount line on the invoice?

Two other asks from security: we need a short evidence bundle confirming invoice recipient and billing contact.

Would appreciate an outline of how Redwood would map our PO fields to your invoice metadata and what the implications are for discount eligibility and billing cadence. Our finance lead (cc) needs this before legal signs the blanket PO.

Regards,
Sarah Klein
Senior Procurement Manager | AcmeCo
procurement@acmeco.com

Attachment: AcmeCo_PO_83421.pdf (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@acmeco.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeco.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Purchase headers & billing cadence — sample PO attached

Sarah — thank you, and great to meet the team.

Short answers up front: yes, we can map PO header fields into invoice metadata and show a discount line item. We typically default to net30 but we do offer net45 for enterprise customers with approval. Monthly consolidated invoices are supported (one invoice per accounting period).

A few clarifying questions so I can loop in Finance for the approval flow:
- Is the "Cost Center" value going to change per invoice, or will you provide a static Cost Center per PO? If it varies per invoice, we need a mapping table to avoid rework.
- For the quarterly-volume discount: can you share the commit thresholds (e.g., $X/month or Y seats) and whether discounts are retroactive if commit is missed?
- Regarding GL code: do you want us to include the 6-digit GL on the invoice line item or only in the header metadata? Our billing system can do either.

I've attached a billing template (redwood_billing_template.xlsx) that shows the header fields we can populate and the spots where discounts appear. If you can confirm the three bullets above I will escalate to Finance for a formal exception to net30. If Finance approves net45, we typically ask for an amended SOW or an invoice amendment signed before the first invoice.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm Cost Center cadence and discount thresholds.
2) I open an internal request with Finance to approve net45 for the first 60 days or first two invoices.
3) If approved, we produce a draft amendment (DocuSign) and enable the PO-field mapping ahead of the first billed period.

Thanks — I can be flexible on timing.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Marissa/Vivek — looping you in on AcmeCo. Procurement sent a sample PO and they require GL/Cost Center headers, monthly consolidated invoices, and want net45 for new vendors. They also want a quarterly-volume discount surfaced on invoices (slab-based).

My ask: can Finance provisionally approve net45 for the first two invoices so we can close the blanket PO this week? If we make net45 an exception, I recommend tying a 10% onboarding discount that is conditional on them providing a signed amendment and a firm quarterly commit (this protects our unit economics).

Notes/constraints:
- If we support monthly consolidated invoices with a discount line, billing will need the GL mapped into the invoice header (they prefer header-level GL).
- If Cost Center changes per invoice, billing will need a CSV mapping or a consistent PO field to avoid manual interventions.
- We should require an initial pre-bill (first invoice) to be reviewed by AP before we move to auto-posting.

I can draft the amendment once you confirm approval path.

Ben — ok to proceed with the proposed path with controls. Approve net45 as an exception for the first two invoices only, conditional on: 

1) Signed amendment (DocuSign) that includes the PO field mapping appendix and states that subsequent invoices revert to net30 unless a formal extension is approved.
2) Acme provides either a static Cost Center per PO or a CSV mapping cadence no less than monthly. If they cannot provide the mapping we will require manual remittance and flag for potential extra ops fees.
3) Discount slab: grant a one-time 10% onboarding discount applied to the first invoice if the quarterly commit is >= $150k. Retroactive discounts only on explicit approval.

Ben — please create the HubSpot deal (D-83421) with the proposed amendment as an attachment and send the DocuSign link to Sarah. Finance will sign off on payment terms once amendment is uploaded. I'll ask Billing to prepare the invoice template with header GL and discount line enabled.
